patch_description:
Crossover of the best-performing prior script (score 0.94: hexagonal staggered-row constructor with self-consistent spacing fixed point + Gauss-Seidel water-fill radii, fast at 0.13s) with the constraint-repulsion refinement from the other programs. The new program:

1. Builds the 6-row hex layout (4,5,4,5,4,4) with the fixed-point spacing so bottom/top rows touch the walls optimally.
2. Applies a short deterministic repulsion refinement (moves each center away from active constraints — overlapping neighbors and walls) with periodic Gauss-Seidel radius updates. This improves centers without expensive LP calls per step.
3. Computes final radii with the exact scipy LP (maximizing the sum subject to pair/wall constraints); falls back to the always-feasible Gauss-Seidel water-fill + monotone repair if scipy is unavailable.

This combines the 0.94-scoring constructor/radius solver with the center refinement that helped other variants, while avoiding the slow per-step LP hill-climb that made the current program take 10.67s.
